hook: One hundred dollars a month is money most people spend without noticing. Invested for 20 years, it can become tens of thousands of dollars. In this video I run the real math from three angles: what $100 a month becomes at different returns, after fees, taxes and inflation; the psychology that stops people from starting; and the exact order to invest it in.
